title.narrative: % of targeted schools that received reading books through the project

comment.narrative: <p>Achieved.  With a baseline of 0 and a target of 100%, this indicator was achieved exactly, with 100% of targeted schools receiving reading books through the project. </p>

title.narrative: Number of primary schools implementing grants through the project

comment.narrative: <p>Exceeded.  With a baseline of 0 and a target of 960, this indicator was exceeded, with 1,145 primary schools implementing grants through the project.</p>

<p>Exceeded.  This target was upwardly revised during the first restructuring from 900,000 to 1,190,000 in order to account for the expansion in the definition of <em>direct project beneficiary,</em> which initially included only the students and teachers in the targeted schools.  Specifically, given the addition of Component 4 and corresponding new activities during the EVD crisis, it was necessary to account for the school-aged children who benefited from the activities supported under Component 4 during the months of Ebola-inflicted school closures as well.  Overall, the baseline for this indicator at the beginning of the project was 0, and the closing expected end target was 1,230,761. The achieved target is 1,262,515.</p>
<p>The percentage of female beneficiaries reached was also achieved.  Specifically, 50% of female beneficiaries were reached, starting from a baselineof 0. Though the target percentage of this indicator (50%) was not upwardly revised across the project's restructurings and AFs, the number of females reached did as a result of increases in the number of targeted direct project beneficiaries. </p>

title.narrative: Number of preprimary schools established under the project

comment.narrative: <p>Achieved.  With a baseline of 0 and a target of 50, this indicator was achieved exactly, with 50 preprimary schools being established under the project. </p>

title.narrative: Number of trained teachers under the project

comment.narrative: <p>Exceeded.  With a baseline of 0 and a target of 4,500, this indicator was exceeded, with 5,400 teachers being trained under the project.</p>

title.narrative: Percentage of schools that meet 60% of performance targets

comment.narrative: <p>Although this target was not achieved by the project's original revised closing date (December 2017), it was achieved by the revised closing date (under AF 2).</p>

title.narrative: TSC policy and guidelines for teacher management in use

comment.narrative: <p>Although this target was not achieved by the project's original revised closing date (December 2017), it was later modified to an IRI indicator under AF 2 and was achieved by the closing date under AF 2 (December 2019). </p>

title.narrative: Transfer of teacher records from MEST to TSC

comment.narrative: <p>Not achieved.  This indicator was not achieved by the project's original revised closing date (December 2019).  However, though it was not replicated under AF 2 as an indicator, it was nevertheless achieved by the closing date under AF 2 (December 2019).</p>

title.narrative: Guidelines for licensing and registration of teachers developed

comment.narrative: <p>Achieved.  The guidelines for the licensing and registration of teachers was developed by the project's original revised closing date (December 2017).</p>
<p>Achieved.  The learning assessment was completed by the project's original revised closing date (December 2017).</p>
<p>Achieved.  The organogram of the TSC was approved before the project's original revised closing date (December 2017).</p>
<p>Achieved.  The report on the ESP was completed by the project's original revised closing date (December 2017).</p>

title.narrative: % of trained teachers using improved reading methods

comment.narrative: <p>Exceeded.  The target of 70 has been met and exceeded, with 84% of trained teachers using improved reading methods.</p>

title.narrative: Number of donors working with Ministry through coordinating unit

comment.narrative: <p>Exceeded.  The target of 5 has been slightly exceeded, with 7 donors working with the Ministry by the project's original closing in December 2017.</p>
<p>Achieved.  Added during first level II restructuring in response to the EVD crisis.  The target of reopening 8,100 schools has been met, exactly.</p>

title.narrative: Percentage of payroll teachers who are teaching in schools where they have been authorized to teach (under AF)

comment.narrative: <p>Achieved.  Specifically, the target of 75% was exceeded, with 88% of payroll teachers teaching in schools where they have been authorized to teach.</p>

title.narrative: Number of community level meetings recording feedback on performance-based school grants (under AF)

comment.narrative: <p>Exceeded.  Introduced under AF 2, this indicator was exceeded.  With a baseline of 0 and a target of 1000, 1,242 community-level meetings recording feedback on performance-based school grants were held.</p>

title.narrative: Number of primary schools implementing grants through the AF

comment.narrative: <p>Exceeded.  With a baseline of 0 and a target of 1,500, this indicator was exceeded, with 1,850 primary schools implementing grants through the project.</p>

title.narrative: Number of school censuses conducted by the MEST (under AF)

comment.narrative: <p>Exceeded.  Added to the RF under AF 2, the number of school censuses conducted by the MEST was exceeded.  With a baseline of 0 and a target of 1, the project conducted 2 school censuses by the closing date under AF 2 (December 2019).</p>

<p>Exceeded.  The baseline was 0, and the expected end target was 500,000. The achieved target is 517,815.</p>
<p>The percentage of female beneficiaries reached was also achieved.  Specifically, 50% of female beneficiaries were reached, starting from abaseline of 0. Though the target percentage of this indicator (50%) was not upwardly revised across the project's restructurings and AFs, the number of females reached did as a result of increases in the number of targeted direct project beneficiaries. </p>

title.narrative: Percentage of schools that meet 60% of performance targets (under AF)

comment.narrative: <p>Achieved.  Whilst this was not achieved by the project's original revised closing date, it was achieved by the closing date under AF 2 (December 2019).  Specifically, the target of 85% has been met, slightly exceeded at 86%.  No changes were made to increase or decrease this target during AF 2.</p>

title.narrative: TSC policy and guidelines for teacher management in use (under AF)

comment.narrative: <p>Although this target was not achieved by the project's original revised closing date (December 2017), it was later modified to an IRI indicator under AF 2 and was achieved by the closing date under AF 2 (December 2019).</p>
